statements.text: We decided to use stdlib http in `tars/providers/base.py` rather than adding httpx.
Going with sqlite for the run log; postgres is more than this needs.
The convention here is one commit per module, so partial progress survives an interrupted run.
From now on every phase appends its own block to `run/summary.log`.
We settled on 88 columns to match ruff's default rather than arguing about it.
Standardised on `from __future__ import annotations` at the top of every module.
I chose to keep the scorer deterministic so two runs over one transcript can be compared byte for byte.
Switching to `os.replace` for store writes so an interrupted run cannot leave a truncated partition.
We agreed that the review queue is one file rather than one per domain.
Prefer `propose` over the CLI for anything programmatic.
The confidence thresholds live in `types.py`, not at the call sites.
